scope.role: current Wenzhou instance of Map Mother concepts; not the complete cross-domain Map Mother platform

canonicalSpatialBasis.rule: one shared spatial identity; time states do not create separate worlds

stateModel.preferred: locked shared basis + semantically typed temporal changes
stateModel.checkpointPolicy: prefer sparse reusable changes, but permit native snapshots or checkpoints when they are necessary for verification, cheaper than accumulated deltas, or required by major base changes
stateModel.fullEpochDemPolicy: not the default and never duplicated casually; not globally forbidden

storageModel.runtimeRule: keep only the knowledge and state needed for query/render; do not carry source scans as routine runtime payload
storageModel.sourceImageExitRule: after extraction, record what was preserved and what remains unextracted; then decide whether the source can exit active storage. Do not assume automatic permanent cold storage and do not delete before required evidence is preserved.
storageModel.compressionRule: reuse stable basis; use quantized coordinates, semantic state changes, sparse masks/residuals and source identity/hash where appropriate
storageModel.sizeReference: the user-approved approximately 2.x MiB compact Wenzhou result is a behavior reference, not a hard unverified byte target

sourceIntake.scope: temporary workflow choice for the current Wenzhou task only; not a global Map Mother rule
sourceIntake.reason: finish digesting current maps into a clean 1940s state before asking the user for more detailed maps
reopenWhen: raw engineering guide lines are absent from the normal visual scene
1940s land-water/coast state is built and reviewed
high-confidence reclamation and reservoir changes are encoded reversibly
a size report confirms no accidental full-map duplication

activeEpoch.rule: finish this short historical window before expanding to later decades

sources.role: nearby-era coarse control; not automatically 1940s truth
nearby-era coarse control; not automatically 1940s truth
nearby-era coarse control; not automatically 1940s truth
finer local historical control for the city area

historicalEvidence.precedence: finer verified evidence may override coarse evidence only within its valid footprint; date compatibility must still be checked
historicalEvidence.displayRule: raw extraction/control geometry is backend evidence; the normal view should show reconstructed historical state rather than engineering guide lines

bathymetryCandidate.rule: derived seabed may be constructed as a replaceable candidate using explicit constraints and method records; it must remain distinguishable from observed/archive bathymetry
bathymetryCandidate.replacementRule: when better bathymetry arrives, replace only affected candidate regions and recheck dependent results

truthBoundary.historicalCoast: may be inferred between reliable controls when source roles, method and reversibility are recorded
truthBoundary.bathymetry: inferred seabed is derived candidate, never silently promoted to observed truth
truthBoundary.reservoir: modern reservoir/dam can be removed from a historical state when absence is secure; drowned-valley elevation remains derived until supported
truthBoundary.minorFeatures: absence on 1:250000 sheets is not proof that small roads, bridges, drains or buildings did not exist
truthBoundary.registration: apparent change must be separated from map registration error where possible

implementedOrPresent: Map Mother concept and Wenzhou-instance knowledge entries
notYetImplementedOrVerified: systematic reversible reclamation and reservoir deltas
derived seabed candidate field and dependency invalidation
